name: counterfeit tycoon
desc:
💵  print counterfeit bills 💰
⚠️ defend your base from the cops 👮
🔫 shoot and steal from other players 💥

game is in beta. content updates and bugs fixes coming out regularly

if you find any bugs or have ideas please join the community linked under the game and let us know!!

a tycoon/incremental game, art heavily inspired by lumber tycoon 2. in the game, you print money and fill up boxes to then load them into your car to sell. you also have to defend your base from armed police in a tower defense style battle. the game includes over 200 tycoon upgrades to buy, multiple npc enemies, various cars to unlock, an armory which you buy guns and armor at, and the ability to pvp with other player and steal from their base

check out teknotic_'s socials linked under this description, he made all the music for the game.

if you enjoy please please leave a like also maybe favorite thanks!!!!!!
